objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object in the P&R Management system that can be created, edited, released, and distributed, subject to versioning and approval workflows.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: A document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: A document type that documents regulations and instructions at a local or business process level.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: A document type that describes specific procedures, process sequences, details and responsible persons.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary object attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document object automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A request to amend an existing document without affecting its content or version history.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to check document validity before expiration.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that no longer has additional validity.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned to perform specific roles and receive specific authorizations and distributions.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: A user or group with permission to view approved documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: A user responsible for creating and signing a document in the workflow.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: A user with personal change rights on a document but no relevance in the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: A user responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: A user responsible for approving and distributing a document to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: A user authorized to translate released content into another language.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users and user groups assigned to receive document distributions.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group that retains read access to archived documents while other users lose access.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of a new information object with selection of document type to establish a new document in the system.

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modification of document content and properties after creation.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Updating standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes within document categories.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of document to PDF format upon saving.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of group and person-related authorizations including reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser and translator roles.

evts.name: add_additional_information
evts.description: Attachment of supplementary objects to a document that are not subject to the main document release cycle.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachment of controlled document objects that are automatically released with the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a request to amend an existing document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Adoption of a change proposal that creates a new version of the document.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature by workflow participants to document approval at each workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Approval and publication of document by releaser to make it visible to readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document after release to make it visible to assigned readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new version of released document with retention of previous version data.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachment for archiving when no longer relevant to new document version.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated request creation when document reaches 30 days before validity expiration.

evts.name: check_validity_extension
evts.description: Review and decision by releaser or release process participants on document validity continuation.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation of extended validity and update of valid until date by default period.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of request to invalidate and archive a document with no additional validity.

evts.name: process_override_request
evts.description: Workflow-supported processing of override request through check and approval steps.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declaration of document and attachments as invalid and initiation of archiving process.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdrawal of authorizations for document with exception of archive group access.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Approval of reactivation request and creation of new version of archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restoration of invalidated document with retained metadata and properties and reactivation of archived attachments.

evts.name: assign_distribution_list
evts.description: Assignment of user groups and persons to distribution list for document distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Sending email notifications to assigned users and user groups upon document release.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported request for active confirmation of document acknowledgement by assigned recipients.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by recipient of document acknowledgement through workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Review and formal/technical check of translated document version.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approval and publication of translated document version to authorized readers in corresponding language.

o2o.description: Policy is a type of document at the strategic level.
Guideline is a type of document at the business process level.
Work instruction is a type of document describing specific procedures.
Additional information can be attached to a document.
Attachment is a controlled document object linked to a main document.
Change proposal is associated with and belongs to a document.
Validity extension request is linked to a document to be checked.
Override request is created for a selected document.
Reactivation request is created for a selected document to be reactivated.
Author users are assigned to author user groups.
Reviewer users are assigned to reviewer user groups.
Releaser users are assigned to releaser user groups.
Reader users are assigned to reader user groups.
Translator users are assigned to translator user groups.
Archive group is a user group that retains read access to archived documents.
Distribution list contains user groups assigned to receive distributions.

o2e.description: Document is created in the system.
Document content and properties are modified.
Document metadata and attributes are updated.
Document is automatically converted to PDF.
Authorizations are assigned to control document access.
Additional information is attached to document.
Attachment is added to document.
Change proposal is created for document.
Change proposal is implemented in new document version.
Author signs document in creation workflow step.
Reviewer signs document in review workflow step.
Releaser signs document in release workflow step.
Translator signs translated document version.
Document is approved and released by releaser.
Document is automatically published after release.
New version of released document is created.
Attachment is marked for archiving.
Validity extension request is generated by system.
Releaser checks document validity extension.
Author participates in checking validity extension.
Reviewer participates in checking validity extension.
Document validity is extended and valid until date is updated.
Override request is created for document.
Override request is processed through workflow.
Document is declared invalid and archived.
Document authorizations are withdrawn for archiving.
Reactivation request is created for archived document.
Reactivation request is confirmed and new version created.
Archived document is restored and reactivated.
Archived attachments are reactivated with document.
Distribution list is assigned to document.
User groups receive email distribution notification.
Users in distribution list receive email notification.
Reader is requested to confirm document acknowledgement.
User group members are requested to confirm acknowledgement.
Reader confirms document acknowledgement.
Document content is translated into another language.
Translator translates document content.
Translator checks translated document version.
Reviewer checks translated document version.
Releaser approves translated document version.
